title.en: The right to vote and your voter information card
title.fr: Le droit de vote et votre carte d'information de l'électeur

text.en: Canadian citizens have the privilege of voting. Voting is a right that comes with citizenship.
text.fr: Les citoyennes et citoyens canadiens ont le privilège de voter. Le vote est un droit qui vient avec la citoyenneté.

source.quote: One of the privileges of Canadian citizenship is the right to vote.

verification.evidence: One of the privileges of Canadian citizenship is the right to vote. You are eligible to vote in a federal election or cast a ballot in a federal referendum if you are:

text.en: Your voter information card also gives a phone number. Call that number if you need an interpreter or other special help.
text.fr: Votre carte d'information de l'électeur donne aussi un numéro de téléphone. Appelez ce numéro si vous avez besoin d'un interprète ou d'un autre service spécial.

source.quote: The card lists when and where you vote and the number to call if you require an interpreter or other special services.

verification.evidence: Once an election has been called, Elections Canada mails a voter information card to each elector whose name is in the National Register of Electors. The card lists when and where you vote and the number to call if you require an interpreter or other special services.

text.en: If you do not know the number of your local elections office, you can call Elections Canada, in Ottawa, instead.
text.fr: Si vous ne connaissez pas le numéro de votre bureau local d'élections, vous pouvez plutôt appeler Élections Canada, à Ottawa.

source.quote: If you do not receive a voter information card, call your local elections office to ensure that you are on the voters’ list. If you do not have the number, call Elections Canada, in Ottawa, at 1-800-463-6868.
